newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta bourse resumes trading in Elang.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta bourse resumes trading in Elang.

text.p: The Jakarta Stock Exchange allowed trading to resume in shares of property firm PT Elang Realty in the early afternoon session on Tuesday after earlier suspending the firm, an exchange official said.
"We have resumed trading in Elang Realty starting from 0700 GMT," the official told Reuters. He said the exchange had found no irregularities.
The exchange had halted the trading in Elang late in the morning session after it had fallen about 30.43 percent from the market opening.

Elang Realty was the most active stock before the exchange suspended trading, with about 68.7 million shares changing hands. It fell 525 rupiah to 1,200 after touching a high of 1,875 rupiah earlier on Tuesday.
It was at 1,475 rupiah immediately after it resumed trading on active volume.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
